meta.description: Renewable energy Environmental Authorisation applications with polygon centroids from the shapefile release, each matched to its nearest transmission substation. The EA decision date is a lower bound on readiness under Eskom IGCAR criteria.
meta.source: DFFE Renewable Energy EIA Application Database (SHP + XLSX, 2026 Q1), https://egis.environment.gov.za/renewable_energy
meta.method: Centroids read from REEA_OR_2026_Q1.shp and paired to REEA_OR_2026_Q1.xlsx by record order; 99.7% of centroids fall within their stated province, confirming alignment. Nearest substation by great-circle distance to the 185 verified substation positions.
meta.caution: An EA is not a grid allocation, and nearest substation is a proxy for the likely connection point, not a declared one. Declared capacity may differ from what is built.
